order: Tighten launch discipline for the cross-vendor executor and reviewer launchers. Ensure every launcher starts from the repository root rather than an arbitrary working directory, so relative paths resolve consistently regardless of where the parent process was invoked from. Route each launcher's output into the shared scratch directory instead of leaving files scattered wherever the process happened to run. Pin the review warmup step to a known checkout so it exercises the same state the review will actually run against, not a stale or unrelated one. Apply the same three fixes across the base executor, the heavy executor, and the reviewer launcher scripts so their startup behavior stays consistent with one another. Keep each script's existing command-line interface unchanged; only the startup and warmup discipline changes.
claims: We fixed launch discipline across all three launcher scripts: each now starts from the repository root, writes its output to the scratch directory, and pins the review warmup to the checkout under test. The three files changed by 90 insertions and 24 deletions, with the base executor, heavy executor, and reviewer launchers kept consistent with one another. Each script's startup path was traced manually to confirm the repo-root working directory takes effect before any relative-path use.
